implementation.scope: default-off region-scoped SNr conductance bundle on one shared SimulationBridge
required_currents: persistent sodium activation and slow inactivation
calcium concentration state and calcium-activated SK

equation_contract.current_sign: I_channel = g_max * gates * (V - E); inward current is subtracted from total ionic current
equation_contract.initialization: all gates initialize at steady state for each neuron's initial voltage; calcium initializes at its nonnegative baseline
equation_contract.calcium_update: nonnegative influx from inward calcium current plus first-order decay; exact scale and decay are configuration values recorded in every run
equation_contract.sk_activation: first-order approach to a saturating function of intracellular calcium
equation_contract.stageA_parameter_meaning: numerical equation tests only; values are not selected or reported as adult SNr biology

required_tests: current direction and voltage dependence for every current
bounded finite gates and calcium at dt 0.01, 0.05, and 0.1 ms
calcium accumulation, decay, and SK recruitment
steady-state initialization without a zero-gate startup transient
default-off no-allocation and exact six-seed compatibility
region isolation on a multi-region HH bridge
independent NALCN, NaP, calcium, SK, and Ih lesions
legacy default-off checkpoint loads with bundle state None
normal and supported fast-path state parity

performance.execute_after: complete StageA correctness and compatibility pass

stop_rules: any bundle state allocated when no region enables it
any active path silently omits a configured current
any nonfinite or out-of-range gate or calcium state
any missing or malformed enabled checkpoint state
any per-step host channel calculation or device synchronization
any access to calibration, replication, held-out, or future-selector seeds
any parameter sweep or physiology claim from StageA
